description: Revert to the proven aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) with Depth 10, as historical data consistently shows this configuration converges faster to a lower loss floor (~0.983) within the 5-minute budget compared to the conservative 0.06 LR which under-utilizes the time, while maintaining the stable WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to prevent early divergence.
